scripts.deploy: node scripts/check-release.mjs && npx --yes firebase-tools deploy --only storage --project faxton-rentals && npx --yes firebase-tools deploy --only firestore:rules --project faxton-rentals && npx --yes firebase-tools deploy --only hosting --project faxton-rentals
scripts.update: git pull origin main && npm run deploy
